messages:
maria_support: FYI — customer Claire (claire@example.com) reports promo code 'GUEST-TRIAL-50' is rejected as invalid/expired when redeeming from the Android app. Screenshot attached. Error shown in-app: 'Code invalid or expired'. She says it worked last week and this started after an account merge. @jordan_eng can you take a look?

jordan_eng: Can you paste the exact API response + x-req-id header? Is this flowing through /v1/claims or a billing endpoint?

maria_support: Pasted below. Request id header: x-req-id: req_0ab12c

```
curl -X POST https://api.redwood.ai/v1/claims \ 
  -H 'Authorization: Bearer sk_live_xxx' \ 
  -d '{"code":"GUEST-TRIAL-50","email":"claire@example.com","source":"android"}'
```

Response: 422
```
{
  "error": {"code":"promo_invalid","message":"Code invalid or expired","details": {"promo_id":"p_9x7","expires_at":"2026-01-15T00:00:00Z"}}
}
```

jordan_eng: Quick checklist: 1) promo actually expired? 2) tenant/org mismatch after merge? 3) unicode/hidden character mismatch from app paste. @sam_billing can you dump promo row p_9x7 and redemption state?

sam_billing: pulling the row now — looks odd. DB shows code value stored as `GUEST-TRIAL-50\u00A0` (trailing NBSP). Created: 2025-12-01, expires: 2026-01-15, redemptions 1/100. Claimed_by NULL. Query: `SELECT code, expires_at FROM promos WHERE id='p_9x7';` -> `GUEST-TRIAL-50\u00A0`, `2026-01-15T00:00:00Z`.

jordan_eng: That matches hypothesis #3. Mobile paste likely strips normal spaces but kept a non-breaking space in DB when merchant created code (or copy from marketing banner). Our claim service trims ASCII whitespace but doesn't normalize NBSP. Short-term: add unicode whitespace trim and normalization (NFKC) on incoming code before lookup. Longer-term: backfill DB to normalize codes and add validation on code creation/copy UI.

ops_bot: deploy request queued by @jordan_eng. Deploying claim-service hotfix v2.4.3-hotfix -> prod.

maria_support: Can we manually grant the trial to Claire while hotfix deploys? She's blocked and needs access today. Ticket TICKET-4591.

sam_billing: Manual credit applied: 14-day trial credit granted to claire@example.com. Journal ID jb_20260301_77. Notified customer via email and added note on the account. Also queued DB sanitize job to replace trailing NBSPs and run lint on promo codes.

jordan_eng: Patch merged and deployed. Backfill script scheduled: will run once during low-traffic window and add a migration to normalize promo codes (strip unicode category Zs). Also adding dashboard validation to prevent copying promo text with NBSP.

maria_support: Customer confirmed receipt of trial and can redeem now :tada:. Closing for now — follow-up needed to confirm backfill completes. Thanks everyone!

sam_billing: Follow-up created: #jira/INF-2127 (promo-code-normalize). Assign to @sam_billing and @jordan_eng.

jordan_eng: FYI — small note for ops: product marketing sometimes pastes copied codes from Google Slides which insert NBSPs. We'll add a tooltip.

maria_support: closing thread.
